_readme: PROVENANCE RULE, same as the ETIM map: no feature-ID enters this file from memory. Every
entry below was READ from a live Icecat API response and the response that produced it is
recorded in `observed_from`. A guessed feature-ID would silently mis-join every record that
uses it, and would be indistinguishable from a correct one until someone compared values.
This is a PARTIAL map, seeded from one Open-tier product. The complete map needs Icecat's
reference files (FeaturesList), which require credentials the operator must supply -
[OPERATOR] item. Feature-IDs with no entry here are written to
data/schema/icecat-feature-backlog.json by the importer: a named gap, never a guess.
The feature ID is the join key precisely because it is language-independent: the same ID
carries 'Switch-Typ' in de and 'Switch type' in en. The previous importer de-duplicated on
the localised display name and threw the ID away.

observed_from.note: Open-tier product; Cisco/HPE return 403 until Full Icecat + brand authorization
